title: F-1 Duration of Status ends
summary: DHS final rule replaces open-ended 'duration of status' for F/J/I visa holders with a fixed admission period and an extension-of-stay process. On Sep 14, 2026, a federal judge in Massachusetts granted a nationwide preliminary injunction, one day before the rule's effective date. D/S stays in place while the lawsuit continues.

title: $100,000 H-1B fee
status: Proposed rule, comments open through Sep 24
summary: Presidential proclamation imposed a $100,000 payment on new H-1B petitions for workers outside the US. DHS is now codifying a fee through rulemaking; comment period on the NPRM closes Sep 24, 2026.

title: $100,000 OPT fee
status: Cleared White House review; not yet published
summary: DHS is drafting a rule that would attach a $100,000 fee to Optional Practical Training. Reported July 2026, sent to the White House (OIRA) for review in August, review completed by Sep 13. Nothing is in effect: the proposed rule still has to be published in the Federal Register for public comment. No official DHS document yet.

DHS sends proposed OPT fee rule to OIRA for regulatory review
OIRA completes review; Federal Register publication expected next

title: CPT must be required by curriculum
summary: Two SEVP broadcast messages (Aug 12 and Aug 24, 2026) tell DSOs that CPT may be authorized only when the training is an integral, required part of the established curriculum, required of all students in the program regardless of immigration status, and needed to complete the degree. Course credit alone is not enough. Not a new regulation, but SEVP may request documentation. Hits day-1 CPT programs and optional internships.
